# Manager catalog independent original captures

Captured unchanged original constructors, callback policies and real Cython Params
before any native tool implementation. Full original checker/probe baseline:
116 scenarios,63 ordered complete descriptors across64configurations and25raw
environment snapshots,10573nonfatal predicates and24actual SIGABRT boundaries.
Every source result and ordered Params/GPS read/write prefix comes from the
original reference, not the Rust runtime catalog. Availability validation remains
an independent checker contract against current port inventory/Cargo manifests.

full-original.json stores all116original request objects and exact original
request-byte SHA256 values, all source logical results and fatal access prefixes.
The raw request files remain in ignored evidence; generator tests must compare
every raw-byte hash, so parsing/re-encoding cannot silently narrow admission.
Environment values use hex only to preserve the original raw0xffcase. The full
original paired baseline passed65.68seconds with a freshly built #296probe.

generic-original.json contains38additional unchanged-reference JSON/Params
admission and failure controls:18successes,19ordinary errors,1SIGABRT. Includes
dynamic started/not_car values,NaN,ignored fields/unknown value keys,source catch
boundaries,raw integer prefixes,NUL,lazy conversion and malformed input. Original
result JSON remains encoded text to retain Python nonfinite/codepoint behavior.
Raw stdout/stderr remain private/ignored. One original error metadata line retains
the build-machine path for its synthetic directory-repeat case; it contains no
vehicle settings, credentials or user capture. Expected logical results and
error categories are separate from that diagnostic metadata.

cli-original.json retains11actual original CLI admission/help results. The new
native tool intentionally removes the obsolete Cython binding positional: native
checker BINARY OUTPUT [--runner REMAINDER], companion REQUEST OUTPUT. It does not
pretend to verify or execute an interpreter binding after retirement.

manifest.json binds all fixtures,24original semantic/import/getter source hashes,
original full receipt/report and ELF identities. Only the two retired tool paths
may become absent; any present tool must retain its original hash, and all other
required source pins must remain present and exact. Shared
original_params_binding.py stays for its other consumers.

Ignored evidence and reproducible capture scripts are under
.analysis/scratch/2026-10-18-manager-catalog-tools/. Existing venv/bindings were
used read-only with bytecode disabled; no build/install/device action was used
for capture. Parent freshly built/froze catalog-probe-baseline independently.
The native two-tool implementation was written only after the observed missing-API
RED. The final gate passed ten manager tests and 36 CI routing tests, strict
Clippy, and both binary builds. Tests retain every original input-byte hash,
full logical result/type, ordered trace and fatal prefix. Additional immutable
corpora cover 20 module-global getattr/call/deferred-serialization controls,
five surrogate/NUL/bytes-overflow admission boundaries, and six checker child/
filesystem failure phases. A missing-candidate regression first failed because
fingerprinting preempted the source child; unavailable child identity is now
diagnostic and the original source-child phase is preserved.

The frozen final native checker passed all 116 scenarios with PATH empty. All
116 generated request byte arrays and all 116 independent source result/access
prefix objects exactly matched the unchanged original baseline; all 116 full
candidate result objects also matched. Original top-level summary fields,
candidate hash and stdout bytes remain exact. The trace records 233 exec
attempts and zero interpreters. Fifteen actual CLI/failure controls and all five
extra generic error boundaries also passed using the same frozen binaries.
Current source and both executable hashes were checked before and after proof.

Native process policy uses no runtime candidate catalog/Params/integer functions
and no fixture lookup. Only the mechanical generic JSON/process/filesystem
utilities are shared. The report distinguishes executing native identities from
immutable original binding/probe provenance. Cython's integer abort is preserved
as captured evidence and an identical access prefix; the native reference exits
with fatal_integer and the candidate returns its typed fatal_integer. This is
policy validation, not SIGABRT parity, manager process launch, AGNOS, or device
validation. After deleting the two replaced Python tools, the parent reran all
46 frozen tests and the full 116-scenario proof: all original and candidate
objects still matched, with 233 exec attempts and zero interpreter executions.
